subject: LANDLORD
bill.title: Prohibits class action waivers in residential rental agreements for claims arising from violations of rent control laws.

action.description: Reported out of Assembly Committee with Amendments, 2nd Reading

posted_text:
🔑 Housing
NJ A3997 — NJ Could Block Rental Agreements With Class Action Waivers

New Jersey is considering a law that would ban landlords from including class action waivers in residential rental agreements when rent control violations are involved. This means tenants could still join together in lawsuits against landlords for overcharging rent, even if a waiver is present in the lease. ...
